description: Read where the customer's insurance shopping stands: the stage, what the current goal still needs (by application path), a summary of the application, what Jerry found that isn't on the application yet (suggested) and, when a request is ready, the confirmation to show. It doesn't change anything.

full.description: Include every typed application fact by application path, with sensitive values masked.

intentId.description: The shopping intent id returned by an earlier shopping tool. Omit it to read the customer's most recent open intent.

name: jerry_get_status
title: Shopping status
